title: In development
summary: Built candidates and open testing, clearly separated from live features.
body:
Combined item and spell scaling — not released

The candidate tunes supported numeric fields on 131 observed Ascended items and preserves modest starter upgrades below comparable Normal dungeon rewards. Exact per-item values replace a blanket multiplier for these reviewed families. Unresolved workbook/screenshot conflicts are deferred.

Direct spell damage adds effective Spell Damage once; each ordinary DoT tick adds half, independent of duration. Clients gain 0.1% per heroic INT/WIS on direct damage/healing. DoTs and HoTs do not receive the heroic multiplier. Existing HA healing/HoT formulas remain, Bard rune songs gain no HA rune bonus, and the separate native Bard area-DoT route remains unchanged.

The pet/WPM candidate below is integrated: 750 base caps and Hunt headroom, bounded owner inheritance, complete pet items/augments, earned AAs and named melee effects. Historical THJ observations do not prove every current THJ formula; critical DoT ordering and unobserved effects remain calibration choices. No production installation, signed client publication or player acceptance is claimed.

Warrior/Paladin/Monk shield build — not released

The combined candidate supports one-handed weapon and shield combat with Shield Specialist, Holy Shield, Way of Steel, Healing Light, Blessing of Life and Rage of Rallos. All six Monk attacks participate. Relevant combat benefits follow held classes rather than their selection order; earned ranks and normal skill requirements remain.

Hopebringer and Cloak of the Black Wind gain sympathetic healing. Diaku Armor Fragment supplies a combat proc, Marr's shield provides haste and received healing, Bloodfrenzy Core occupies the power-source slot, and Hastened Fragments of Truth supply temporary attack-speed procs. The original Bloodfrenzy weapon remains a weapon. New families have earned Cursed, Tallon Zek and Seru routes.

A separately controlled heroic-STR multiplier applies to player weapon hits. It does not multiply pet attacks, spells, runes or Monk special attacks. The same candidate retains the pet equipment, augment, inheritance, healing/rune and split Rabid Bear changes described above. Rune and heroic-scaling values are Nightcap choices, not certified THJ formula parity.

This is not deployed. Combined native combat validation and actual client gameplay acceptance precede release. Live equipment, progression, commands and reward-catalog values remain unchanged.

Pet builds and shared combat scaling — not released

This built candidate adds 22 selectable equipment locations, with a budget of 15 persistent items for Mage pets and 8 for other permanent class pets. Temporary summoned hand-ins remain separate. Two-handed equipment excludes the secondary hand. Stored gear, augments and customization remain recoverable.

Eligible permanent pets use their actual weapon augments for independent proc attempts. They gain half their owner's effective item Spell Damage and Healing Amount, capped at 375 each, in addition to their own gear. The shared player base caps become 750 with existing earned hunt headroom retained. Earned caster AA transfers, roster buffs, direct pet healing and coexisting Mage/Necromancer/Beastlord buff lines are included. These changes also affect WPM healing and proc scaling.

Rabid Bear becomes two separately removable permanent effects: the benefit and Illusion: Rabid Bear. Removing one leaves the other. Normal death behavior remains. The candidate also gives marked Enchanter Doppelgangers a bounded spell assistant that uses the owner's memorized, scribed, level-eligible spells and resources; native combat and movement remain.

Healing and Runic Fragments of Truth, selected gear bonuses and a second combat socket on four weapon families are staged. Their new proc magnitudes are Nightcap calibration values. The earned level-65/Planes of Power profile adds native-vendor scroll stock without granting levels, spellbooks, AAs or epics. Manifest Elements retains its normal Mage level 59 requirement.

None of this candidate is deployed. Native-client equipment, buff removal, zoning, travel and combined pet/WPM/caster combat validation remain open. Current live guides and reward values remain applicable.

Guaranteed quality for qualifying quest rewards

Automatic Ascended armor and weapon rewards are under consideration for reviewed quests, excluding repeatable or easily farmed quests. This is not implemented; ordinary quests do not automatically grant Ascended rewards.

Remaining shared skill and spell cooldowns

The AA and cross-ability timer correction is deployed for live testing. Content-defined groups, including Harmshield/Cannibalize and Battle Cry/Throw Stone, remain open work. Bash/Slam, Backstab, Frenzy and non-Monk Kick still share a basic attack timer; Begging and Pick Pockets also share reuse. Linked potion/item groups remain. These links are under review; they are not included in the independence correction.

Adventure Journal & Epic 0.5

The eight journal quests and Wayfarer’s Oath charm have been built but are not installed on the server. The candidate uses three shared chapters followed by Guardian, Striker, Arcanist, Warden or Binder paths. These are not available rewards.

Combat and item candidates

Broader Monk and Beastlord fist-damage formulas and some existing tiered item corrections have a tested candidate but no recorded deployment. A frozen personal casting bar remains under investigation. The separate extra-class skill, trainer and offhand correction is deployed; the reported player issue was confirmed resolved.

Ongoing checks for deployed features

Broader equipment and class combinations, stats, regeneration, ability names and Bard movement/songs still need player checks. Those are acceptance checks for installed systems, not a claim that all of them are unreleased. See Features for the available systems.
